تستكرهي (form X)
# تَسْتَكْرِهِي (tastakrihī) /tas.tak.ri.hiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# تُسْتَكْرَهِي (tustakrahī) /tus.tak.ra.hiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
